name: Red-Eyes B. Chick
source_text: Send this face-up card on your side of the field to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" from your hand.
notes: Sending the source to the Graveyard is the cost for summoning 'Red-Eyes B. Dragon'.
